      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to support options after positional arguments.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents silent bugs where options like -rpcwallet placed after a subcommand were silently ignored by bitcoin-cli and swallowed into positional arguments. This addresses a real footgun when invoking RPCs across different wallets, while remaining reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "The edits in bitcoin-tx are mechanical updates to consume the filtered argument list from the core ArgsManager refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/common/args.cpp and argsman tests to overhaul option parsing to GNU-style.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a significant argument-parsing flaw where trailing options were silently swallowed or ignored after non-option arguments. Adding GNU-style parsing, unrecognized option rejection, and '--' terminator handling delivers substantial user-facing configuration improvements across the binaries."
